name: rabe
description: Watch Claude Code's background work: subagents, Codex jobs, shells, monitors, cron jobs and workflows.

hideBuiltinTasks.title: Hide Claude Code's own background count
hideBuiltinTasks.description: Removes the shells and monitors count and its '↓ to manage' from the hint under the prompt, and the 'still running' part from the line that ends a turn, since Rabe's band shows them. The agent list under the prompt cannot be hidden.

timelineHours.title: Hours the Timeline tab shows
timelineHours.description: The Timeline tab shows the last this many hours; older finished items fold into one line. 0 shows the whole session. A key on the tab widens the window for the open pane.
